summary: DEFSEC Technologies Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on August 17, 2026, disclosing a private placement of common shares and pre-funded warrants. The offering includes 1,951,219 shares (or pre-funded warrants) at CAD$2.84 per share, accompanied by warrants exercisable at CAD$3.30 for 60 months. Gross proceeds are approximately CAD$5.54 million. H.C. Wainwright acts as placement agent. Proceeds fund business development and working capital. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
